topic: how Nintendo started in 1889 as a maker of handmade playing cards
storyAngle: The home of Mario began as a Kyoto card maker more than a century before video games.
doNotClaim: Do not say nineteen eighty nine; the year is eighteen eighty nine.
Do not claim anything about electricity, cars or the world in 1889.
Name variants and founder age differ across sources; do not state either.

facts.claim: Nintendo was founded on 23 September 1889 in Kyoto by Fusajiro Yamauchi, to make handmade hanafuda playing cards.
Nintendo later moved into electronic games.
Nintendo is the company behind Mario and the Switch.
